segments.title: Which CITY has the most people?
segments.say: Guess It twelve was the country with the most people. Part two: which city has the most? Tokyo, Jakarta, or Delhi? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's Jakarta!
segments.say: It's Jakarta! About forty-two million people.

segments.title: Dhaka is #2
segments.say: Dhaka in Bangladesh is number two, with about thirty-seven million.

segments.title: Tokyo fell to #3
segments.sub: It was #1 in the UN's **2000** report
segments.say: And Tokyo, number one in the year two thousand, fell to third.

segments.title: Source: United Nations
segments.say: That's from the United Nations' latest city count.
Follow for Guess It number 16 tomorrow.
